files.rationale: Both PRs add an independent type import (Images from PR A, VersionMetadata from PR B) that the already-merged Binding union references, so both imports are kept.
Kept both imports and chained both new conditional branches (Images -> ImagesBinding, then VersionMetadata -> Fetcher) ahead of the Self/Json/Service fallbacks, re-indented consistently.
Both PRs add a separate else-if branch for their binding type, so both the images and version_metadata branches are kept before the unsupported-type fallback.
